items.title: FlashRT: Agent Harness for Guiding Agents to Deploy Real-Time Multimodal Applications
items.title_zh: FlashRT：引导智能体部署实时多模态应用的智能体框架
items.summary: FlashRT is an agent harness that guides coding agents through a chain-of-program process: translating a reference implementation into an IR, validating it with a sequential interpreter, and iteratively benchmarking candidate transformations to build multi-GPU deployments. It reports up to ~70x latency reduction and 2.8x throughput improvement on NVIDIA B200, and on AMD MI355X cuts Qwen3-Omni text-to-audio latency by 65% versus the expert vLLM-Omni implementation.

items.title: Search-on-Graph-R1: Training Large Language Models to Search Knowledge Graphs with Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: Search-on-Graph-R1：用强化学习训练大语言模型搜索知识图谱
items.summary: Search-on-Graph-R1 trains a compact 8B model to navigate knowledge graphs by supervised fine-tuning on trajectories from a frontier teacher scaffolded with each question's gold SPARQL query, then reinforcement learning against a live Freebase server. It surpasses every frozen frontier-LLM system compared on WebQSP, CWQ and GrailQA, posts the strongest CWQ results in the comparison, and needs fewer Search calls after RL.

items.title: SWE-Pruner Pro: The Coder LLM Already Knows What to Prune
items.title_zh: SWE-Pruner Pro：代码大模型早已知道该剪掉什么
items.summary: SWE-Pruner Pro prunes tool outputs inside a coding agent by turning the agent's own internal representations into per-line keep-or-prune labels, using a small head and a length-aware embedding keyed to each output's line count. Across two open-weight backbones and four multi-turn benchmarks it saves up to 39% of prompt and completion tokens while preserving quality, and on MiMo-V2-Flash raises SWE-Bench Verified resolve rate by 3.8%.

items.title: AHEAD: Advancing Multi-Class Label Aggregation with Interpretable Cross-Annotator Modeling
items.title_zh: AHEAD：面向多分类标签聚合的可解释跨标注者建模
items.summary: AHEAD learns cross-annotator contexts with a graph neural network and decodes them into interpretable annotator-specific confusion matrices to aggregate noisy multi-class crowdsourced labels. On 10 real-world datasets it raises average label accuracy from 68.75% to 73.23%, with a best-case gain of 14.9%.

items.title: Aethel: A Reproducible Graph-Retrieval Framework for Multi-Hop Financial Diligence
items.title_zh: Aethel：面向多跳金融尽职调查的可复现图检索框架
items.summary: Aethel combines bipartite Personalized PageRank graph retrieval, a coreference-aware teleportation layer and specialist agents to answer multi-hop questions over fragmented financial disclosures. It reports HR@5 of 100.0% on 2WikiMultiHopQA and 88.5% on MuSiQue, but on a 4,123-chunk financial corpus graph retrieval does not surpass a strong BM25 baseline at open-corpus scale.

items.title: Attacking Graph Foundation Models Through Their Shared Representation
items.title_zh: 通过共享表征攻击图基础模型
items.summary: The paper identifies the alignment layer that maps inputs into a shared representation as a distinct inference-time attack surface in graph foundation models. A directed representation-space perturbation collapses all six tested models, with OpenGraph's spectral tokenizer collapsing at a fifth of the budget a plain graph network needs, and realizable edge, feature or text edits remove at least half the correct predictions on three models.

items.title: LLMs and Agentic AI Systems for Smart Grids: A Tutorial on Architectures and Applications
items.title_zh: 面向智能电网的大语言模型与智能体系统：架构与应用教程
items.summary: This tutorial reviews prompting strategies and agentic architectures for smart-grid LLM systems and proposes a solver-grounded principle: report a numerical result only when it comes from a trusted tool and passes explicit verification. EVAgent reproduces the CVXPY optimum while cutting LLM-only unmet energy by 7.5–9.5x, and GridDebugAgent repairs 17/39 contingency cases while reducing violations by 52.3%.

items.title: AstrBotDevs/AstrBot
items.title_zh: AstrBot：集成多平台的开源 AI 智能体助手与开发框架
items.summary: AstrBot is an open-source AI agent assistant and development framework that integrates multiple IM platforms, LLMs and plugins, positioned as an openclaw alternative and written in Python.

items.title: Safety and alignment in an era of long-horizon models
items.title_zh: 长时程模型时代的安全与对齐
items.summary: OpenAI shares lessons from deploying long-running AI models, pointing to new safety risks and observed failures as well as safeguards that improved through iterative deployment.

items.title: Kimi K3 Investment Research Capability Benchmarked: Moonshot AI Top Model Now Powers AlphaEngine With First-Tier IRB Scores
items.title_zh: Kimi K3 投资研究能力基准测试：Moonshot AI 顶级模型驱动 AlphaEngine 并取得一线 IRB 成绩
items.summary: AlphaEngine evaluated Kimi K3 on its proprietary IRB investment research benchmark and reports that K3 beats GPT-5.5 and OPUS-4.8 on temporal judgment, evidence boundary control and premise correction; the model is already deployed.
